description: One calculator: what it measures (cem-ui registry/tools.json), its inputs with their defaults, and its formula as the calculator's own code computes it (templates/tool-calcs/{slug}.blade.php: the recalc function, the helpers it calls and its constants), and the citation it gives. Or one self-check (registry/checks.json): its questions, answers, rule and result words from its playbook; with answers, the result it names. Ask the questions in the person's words of the moment, but give the result in the check's own words, and never as a score.

answers.description: Self-checks only: { item id: answer } for ground-check; the marked item ids (or { id: true }) for governance-maturity and working-or-broken
